# Metodi {#ch2}


Sia dato il seguente processo stocastico
$$ X_t = 0.8X_{t-1}  - 0.4X_{t-2} + e_t - 0.1 e_{t-1} \quad \text{con} \quad e_t \sim WNG(0, \sigma^2_e)$$


## Sezione metodi

$\begin{aligned}
\gamma(0)&=E(X_t - \mu)^2 = E(e_t+\theta e_{t-1})^2\\
&=E(e_t^2 + 2\theta e_t e_{t-1} + \theta^2 e_{t-1}^2)\\
&=\sigma^2_e + 0 + \theta^2\sigma^2_e\\
&=(1+\theta^2)\sigma^2_e
\end{aligned}$
